chapter: Hollywood, Ken Murray and the Penguin years
title: Toronto, Preston Love and the Tip Top in Boston
summary: After the Blackouts he travels to Toronto, picks up Preston Love in Omaha, and plays the Tip Top.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: From Ken Murray's Blackouts, they jumped us all the way into Toronto.
Where did you play up in Toronto?
Some kind of Steel Pier, or something like that.
Yeah; I've heard of that.
There's a Steel Pier in Atlantic City; this is a different one.
I'll find a friend of mine, he'll know.
We didn't stay there too long, but I don't remember exactly. I think about a month.
McVae wasn't with you there?
He didn't come.
Is this where you picked up Preston Love?
Preston Love. We were through Omaha and picked up Preston Love.
I knew Preston was with you, but I couldn't think exactly where.
I came through Omaha. I had a special train--a special coach rather. I paid the guys and they paid the
difference and I was able to get a special train; we even stopped at Chicago for a night, for a party at my cousin's.
Who's your cousin?
Bill Jordan, the undertaker.
We went into Toronto and from there we went to Tip Top.
In Boston?
In Boston; yeah. It was a big time place. Louis Jordan was there.
I went in there, and later came back in there.
Preston must have left about that time.
Yeah, he wasn't with me.
He didn't stay with you too long.
No, he didn't.
I needed more of a personality too.
He didn't want to be in show business, although later on he did, when he
had his own band, but I don't think he liked to do it too much at that time.
